question: Why does the self’s course appear twofold as quality and non-quality?
premises: Manifestation occurs as quality and non-quality.
This course belongs to the self so named.
inference: The self’s course appears twofold through manifestation as quality and non-quality.
uncertainties: tadābhidasya may refer to a previously named principle.
plain_english: By manifesting as quality and non-quality, a twofold course of that so-named self shines forth.
